events.title: Russian forces kill six civilians in Zaporizhzhia airstrike
events.summary: On 2026-08-11, Russian forces reportedly used ballistic missiles, drones, and glide bombs in an overnight attack on Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine. Local officials said six people were killed and 19 wounded.

events.title: Russian forces kill 12 in Kyiv airstrikes
events.summary: On 2026-09-01, Russian forces launched air attacks on Kyiv and the surrounding region. Ukrainian emergency services reported 12 people killed and five injured in Kyiv, including three children, with fires at several locations.

events.title: Ukrainian drones hit TANECO oil refinery in Nizhnekamsk, Russia
events.summary: On 2026-08-20, Ukraine reportedly struck the TANECO oil refinery in Nizhnekamsk, Tatarstan, with Ukrainian-made FP-1 drones. Russian monitoring channels reported at least 12 deaths, while footage appeared to show an impact and Russian air-defense interception efforts.

events.title: Russian forces kill 10 in attack on Ukraine
events.summary: On 2026-08-18, the Ukrainian governor reportedly said that 10 people were killed in a Russian attack in Ukraine. The article title does not identify the precise location, weapon, or whether all victims were civilians.

events.title: Russian troops face Ukrainian fire after pipeline infiltration
events.summary: On 2026-08-15, a Russian assault group reportedly crawled about 28 kilometers through a pipeline for three days before emerging near Ukrainian positions. The 71st Separate Airmobile Brigade reportedly engaged the group with fire and drones. Four of 16 Russian soldiers reportedly survived and were captured.
